final: WITH g AS (SELECT cr.raceId AS raceId, c.country AS country, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY cr.raceId, c.country), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM g), f AS (SELECT g.*, g.cnt - a.avg_cnt AS diff FROM g, a WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt) SELECT raceId, country, total_points, cnt AS entry_count, diff AS above_average FROM f WHERE cnt >= (SELECT cnt FROM f ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9) ORDER BY diff DESC
